help.goal: Own more discs than the other player when the board runs out of moves. ⚫ black plays first.
steps: Wait until the top line says your turn.
The squares you may play show a soft white dot — only those can be tapped.
A legal square must trap a straight line of the other colour between your new disc and one of yours.
Every trapped line flips to your colour, in all eight directions at once.
If you have no legal square your turn is skipped and the line under the status says so.
notes: The counter under the board is the live score: black discs, then white.
Corners can never be flipped back — they are worth far more than a big pile mid-game.
The game ends when neither player can move, which is usually but not always a full board. Equal discs is a draw.
Play alone and a bot takes the other seat: Easy plays any legal square, Normal chases corners and edges, Sharp searches four moves ahead.
